_note: Casting sheet for the 31 AI employee portraits. Direction: everyone reads 28-40, attractive and modelesque, deliberately diverse. Expertise is veteran-level regardless of apparent age — depth is in the persona text, not the face. Priya is South Asian to match her name; Wesley (LP relations) is white and blonde per direction.
_style: Editorial fashion-portrait quality headshot. Strikingly attractive, model-like features: excellent bone structure, high cheekbones, symmetrical face, flawless clear complexion, expressive eyes, groomed and polished. Youthful and vibrant. Natural window light from the left, soft neutral grey-warm backdrop, shoulders-up framing, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens look, direct confident eye contact, subtle natural smile, impeccably styled modern business-casual, photorealistic, high-end magazine quality, no text, no logos, no watermark.
